visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with reddish-brown hair, wearing a black hoodie with a Tesla logo, stands in a brightly lit, modern airport terminal at Taoyuan Airport Terminal 3. He holds the camera in a selfie position, speaking directly to it. Behind him, rows of empty grey seats and a large D18 gate sign are visible under a high ceiling with oval-shaped lights. (2) The camera cuts to show a series of light-colored airport chairs and then shifts to large, curved yellow sofas. The man is seen sitting on one of these yellow benches, demonstrating its comfort by reclining back. The background features expansive floor-to-ceiling glass windows that reveal the airport's tarmac and night lighting. (3) The scene transitions to a night-time parking lot where the man is seen by his car, followed by a sequence of instructional shots showing blue airport directional signs for gates A, B, C, and D, and hallways leading to the new terminal. He walks through brightly lit corridors and past duty-free shopfronts like Versace. (4) Back in the Terminal 3 concourse, the man showcases the high-ceiling architecture and white pillar structures. He poses inside a large Instagram-themed frame located near gate D12. Finally, he stands by a large window overlooking the runway where a FedEx cargo plane taxiing is visible.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a practical travel guide to introduce the new Terminal 3 North Concourse at Taoyuan Airport. It combines first-person vlog footage with instructional signage and location shots to show travelers how to reach the new area and what amenities, like comfortable seating and plane-spotting windows, they can expect.
